cards.title: Your infrastructure improves automatically
cards.text: New features, security patches, and compliance updates ship continuously. Your SaaS gets better without you touching a line of infrastructure code.

cards.title: Lower your AI bill
cards.text: Your AI doesn't waste your budget improvising a login flow from scratch every time. It uses Fonderie's building blocks instead. Same result, lower cost.

cards.title: Works with any AI assistant
cards.text: Claude today. Cursor tomorrow. ChatGPT next week. Fonderie's building blocks work the same way regardless of which AI you use. Your product doesn't break when you switch tools. Because Fonderie normalizes every backend component, our team can support you no matter which AI assistant you used to build your app.

cards.title: Talk to customers, not debug auth
cards.text: That month you would have spent fixing login bugs? Spend it understanding your customers and building features they actually want.
